text:
sasha: kicking off multi-region staged rollout for svc-search v3.1.0 -> starting at 5% traffic in us-west + eu-west :rocket:
deploy-bot: rollout initiated: v3.1.0 -> targets: us-west(5%), eu-west(5%) 2026-03-21T14:30Z. monitoring windows: 15m primary, 30m extended.
mike: pinging — any known schema or response changes in this build?
sasha: only change is tokenization fallback + kv-cache tuning. no API contract changes.
maya: seeing a small bump in tail latency on canary in us-west, +90p latency +120ms relative. still within soft SLO but notable.
leo: can you paste the heatmap?
maya: attaching quick snippet —
```
us-west p95: 220ms -> 345ms
us-west p99: 420ms -> 680ms
baseline (v3.0.8)
```
sasha: hmm that's larger than expected. are we seeing error rate too?
maya: 502 spike coincident with p99 increase, ~0.3% of canary requests. stack trace points at kv-cache miss path.
leo: could be kv-cache eviction threshold change from new kernel. tagging infra. @nora can infra look at kernel flags on canaries?
nora: on it — checking node kernel tunables and driver logs.
deploy-bot: autoscaling ramp completed for canary pods. observed 4/5 pods healthy.
oncall-bot: alert created: CANARY_LATENCY_SPIKE - us-west - severity: low.
mike: given the p99 and 502s, i'd vote hold and pin traffic at 5% while we triage. we should NOT shift to 20% yet.
sasha: +1 hold. prefer to pin to v3.0.8 in eu-west if eu is clean, and keep us-west at 5% but paused.
leo: agree. propose: pause further ramp, pin fallback route to v3.0.8 for eu-west if any signal. also open rollback plan ready.
maya: quick repro locally shows kv-cache hit ratio drops ~12% at longer sequences (>=1024 tokens). might be quantization path regression on this model build.
nora: infra found mismatch on kernel tune: `vm.swappiness` set differently on canary host pool vs baseline. pushing fix now.
sasha: action items: 1) hold ramp (deploy-bot) 2) infra push kernel fix (nora) 3) QA run targeted prompt set (mike) 4) update release notes and pin decision (sasha)

deploy-bot: HOLD complete — no further traffic shifts scheduled. current allocation: us-west 5% (v3.1.0), eu-west 5% (v3.1.0). pinned fallback version: v3.0.8 on warm path.
mike: starting targeted eval run now (~150 prompts from regression suite). ETA 12m.
sasha: I'll draft a short note for release-notes: "v3.1.0: tokenizer fallback and kv-cache tuning. Paused rollout due to observed tail latency in us-west; investigating kv-cache path." will post to #release-notes when we have final decision.
leo: if infra fix doesn't remove spike, we should be ready to rollback us-west to v3.0.8. can someone prepare rollback command?
maya: rollback command ready: `deployctl reroute --service svc-search --region us-west --to v3.0.8 --force --reason "canary p99 regression"`
nora: kernel tweak pushed to 3 hosts in canary pool, monitoring. logs show reduced page reclaim pressure so far.

deploy-bot: metric update (14:40Z): us-west p99 trending down from 680ms -> 430ms after kernel tweak. 502s reduced to 0.08%.
mike: evals coming back — 2 prompts show subtle hallucination increase, not huge but measurable (quality delta ~0.7%).
sasha: that's not ideal. combined with earlier latency fuss, i'm leaning rollback for us-west and continue investigating quant path.
leo: +1 rollback us-west. pin eu-west at 5% and keep global rollouts paused.
nora: agreed. initiating canary rollback for us-west.

deploy-bot: ROLLBACK initiated for region us-west -> target v3.0.8. ETA for routing change: ~90s.
deploy-bot: ROLLBACK complete for us-west. current allocation: us-west v3.0.8(100% of local traffic), eu-west v3.1.0(5%). overall staged rollout paused.
sasha: filing infra/repro ticket linking traces and QA prompts. tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml.
sasha: release notes draft updated and pinned: "Staged rollout paused due to tail-latency and small quality regression in canary; rollback applied to us-west. Investigation in progress. Do not resume rollout until ENG-RUNTIME + INFRA sign-off."
mike: I'll run deeper evals on regression prompts and instrument kv-cache hits with extra tracing.
leo: ops — do we want to extend change window by 30m to finish triage?
sasha: yes please — +30m. @oncall-bot can you extend the maintenance window?
oncall-bot: change window extended by 30 minutes. new window end: 2026-03-21T15:30Z.
sasha: thanks. final status: HOLD + PIN + ROLLBACK(us-west). next: eng-runtime to triage quant/kernel interaction, infra to validate kernel consistency, QA to finish evals. will reconvene in 30m or earlier if new signal. :handshake:
